title: Rename pgpkeys 'C' to 'the freeze commit'
description: Mark 2026-10-22: 'C' is a terrible name for the last signed pgpkeys.git commit, since C is the language the kernel is written in, and readers also take it for a person. Replace it with 'the freeze commit' everywhere: DESIGN.md (Flag day, Porting pgpkeys, continuity, endorsements), docs/flag-day.md and other guides, git-vouch-migrate help text, messages and comments, and test names/comments. Keep any real C-language mentions. Queued until the two-stream workflow finishes (it is editing the same docs).
acceptance_criteria: grep finds no standalone 'C' meaning the freeze commit in docs, help text, messages or tests; tests pass on 3.12 and 3.9; ruff clean.
